title: paronychia capitata subsp. nivea
intro: Paronychia capitata subsp. nivea, commonly known as Snow Paronychia, is a plant species belonging to the Nyctaginaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Snow Paronychia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
